subject: Follow-up: Pricing & model mix (token volumes + $/1M target)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightlayer.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & model mix follow-up

Alex — thanks again for a great call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on pricing and unit economics before we share an initial SOW.

Recap (from our notes):
- Current production volumes: ~80M tokens/month (inference only) with spikes up to ~300M during peak campaigns.
- 6-month forecast: ~1.1B–1.3B tokens/month if conversion from pilot holds (~10–15% m/m growth).
- Model mix (customer goal / estimated split):
  - Chat (assistant + convo): ~75% of tokens
  - Embeddings (indexing + semantic search): ~20% of tokens
  - Rerank (pairwise scoring): ~5% of tokens
- Target unit economics you mentioned: target $/1M tokens in the range of $100–150 (you said $125 as a sweet spot).

Open items we agreed to:
1) Redwood to send a per-model unit-cost estimate (hosted and reserved options), and a sample $/1M blended number based on the model mix above.
2) Provide a pricing workbook + monthly volumes CSV so you can plug in scenarios (attached).
3) Discuss a Dedicated (reserved) pool option if forecasts sustain — that’s usually where we hit the lower $/1M targets.

Initial ask from our side: can you confirm the model mix above (chat/embeddings/rerank) and the 6-month volume band (1.1B–1.3B)? If those look right, I’ll include two pricing scenarios in the workbook:
- Scenario A: Hosted (pay-as-you-go) with batching + KV caching - projected blended $/1M
- Scenario B: Dedicated reserved pool (monthly commit) with quantization (int8 or 4-bit option) – projected blended $/1M (typically 30–60% lower at scale)

I attached a redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx and a sample volumes CSV. Sending over a 1-page SOW draft next — will flag where we need a signature.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightlayer.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Iqbal <sana@brightlayer.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & model mix follow-up

Thanks Marissa — that matches our notes. A few clarifications from our finance/ops side:

- Confirmed current steady-state: 80M/month (prod). Burst capacity historically up to 300M/month for campaigns.
- Forecast band is accurate: planning for 1.1B–1.3B tokens/month in Q4 if pilot metrics hold.
- Model mix also looks right roughly. One adjustment: embeddings will be higher during reindex windows — say 25% for the first 2 months while we onboard. After that expect 18–20%.
- Budget: currently we can commit ~$15k/month for the pilot. If results are good, finance green-lights expansion up to ~$80k/month within 3–4 months. The $/1M target we mentioned ($125) is what our CFO would like to see as an ongoing blended target at scale.

Can you include per-model $/1M estimates in the workbook (chat vs embeddings vs rerank) and show blended numbers for both Hosted and Dedicated? Also call out assumptions:
- typical batching (tokens/req) and KV/prefix cache hit rates you assumed
- quantization options and expected perf lift (int8 vs int4)
- whether we can get additional discounts if we commit to an annual reserved pool

Happy to sync on a quick 30-min follow-up after you send the workbook — Sana from product ops is on the thread and will coordinate internal timelines.

— Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Product, BrightLayer
alex.turner@brightlayer.ai | +1 212-555-0303

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pricing & model mix follow-up — internal: pricing ask

Marissa / Rishi — looped in for pricing + delivery feasibility. A couple quick notes for the workbook before we send to Alex:

- If BrightLayer is targeting ~$125/1M blended at ~1.2B tokens, we should show:
  - Hosted (baseline): blended $/1M ~= $180–220 (depends on model family and cache)
  - Dedicated (reserved, 12-mo commit, int8 quant + prefix caching): blended $/1M ~= $95–140
  - Key levers: batching (increase effective throughput), caching (prefix/embedding cache), quantization (int8/int4), and model selection (gpt-medium vs gpt-large family).

- For the per-model split, please ensure tabs for: chat (gpt-family conv), embeddings (sparse vs dense), rerank (pairwise scoring). Include a sensitivity slider for cache hit rate (10/30/50%).
- Rishi — can you confirm whether our GPU pool sizing for a 1.2B token/month profile (75% chat) is feasible with 2–3 reserved A100 nodes (or equivalent) with autoscaling/burst? If not, note recommended commit size.

I attached the preliminary SOW (MAP_BrightLayer_SOW_v1.pdf) and a sample volumes CSV. I’ll review the workbook once Marissa drops the initial numbers.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor | Solutions Engineering
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Pricing & model mix follow-up

Alex — thanks for the quick confirmation and the budget transparency. Attached is the pricing workbook (redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx) and a volumes CSV that mirrors the 1.1B–1.3B scenario. High level highlights from the workbook (please see the "Summary" tab):

- Blended $/1M (based on your model mix: chat 75 / embeddings 20–25 / rerank 5):
  - Hosted (pay-as-you-go): ~$200/1M tokens (example assumptions: median batching, 20% cache hit)
  - Dedicated (12-mo reserved + int8 quant + 40% cache hit): ~$110/1M tokens
  - With more aggressive quantization (experimental int4) + higher caching, we can show modeling down to ~$85–95/1M but we mark that as higher risk/quality tradeoffs.

- Per-model examples (1M-token estimates):
  - Chat: Hosted $0.18/token equivalent => $180/1M | Dedicated $0.095/token => $95/1M
  - Embeddings: Hosted $0.25/token-equivalent => $250/1M | Dedicated $0.12/token => $120/1M
  - Rerank: Hosted $0.30/token-equivalent => $300/1M | Dedicated $0.14/token => $140/1M

Notes/assumptions included in the workbook: batching (avg tokens/request), prefix cache hit scenarios (10/30/50%), and expected latency SLOs for each config. Please review the attached workbook — I highlighted the two scenarios we discussed (pilot hosted vs dedicated commit).

Next steps / asks:
1) Confirm model mix and whether embeddings will be ~25% during onboarding (we'll show a 2-month ramp in the workbook).
2) If OK, sign the attached SOW draft (MAP_BrightLayer_SOW_v1.pdf) and indicate whether you prefer monthly vs annual commit for the Dedicated option.
3) If you want, we can set a 30-min follow-up this week to walk through the sheet live (Neha will run the performance/ops Qs).

Link to the HubSpot deal with our pricing summary: https://hubspot.example/deal/BL-2026-Q2-042
Drive folder with the workbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cREDWOODpricing

Thanks — attaching files now.

-Marissa
